objective: The Hexbound enemies in the game: baked, uploaded and rigged models with evil auras, two-legged and winged animations with hit and defeat reactions, a replayable fight log, and an admin-only test wave in the arena with health bars and damage numbers.
acceptance_criteria: BattleRules.battle with a log gives the same result as without, and the log is one entry per attack, in time order, and replays to the same hit points
Every foe has a model of its kind in StationAssets (uploaded), and a sane size and tint
In Studio play the admin menu spawns every enemy with no script errors and the test wave plays to its end, with health bars, damage numbers, deaths and a result toast
The auras cost nothing measurable on a desktop with a large crowd
verification: 2026-11-14: lune 666/666 (3 new fight-log tests, 1 new foe asset test), stylua and selene clean. Blender full bake of the 5 models (2,070 to 9,324 triangles); upload-assets run 43536103082 succeeded. Studio play (stations.rbxl, synced from source): all 14 enemies spawned from the admin menu; test waves 1 (starter team, won in 22 s), 6 (starters) and 10 (starters lost in 19 s to the first dragon, as the balance probe predicted; the best team won wave 10 in 1 s) ran to their ends with health bars falling, floating numbers, deaths and the result toast, and no script errors. Poses checked as held frames: sword chop, bow aim, spell thrust, power attack arms-up, fall onto the back. Aura measured with 42 enemies on screen (about 2,200 particles): 16.7 ms a frame with it on and off. Not checked: a real client other than Studio, phones, a dragon's wing flap in motion, drake and dragon tiers in a fight, the 'mine' team option.
notes: The test wave is admin-only and Studio-or-owner only; nothing in it is saved. Wave fights for ordinary players are still not wired up. The Ogre and Dragon sizes in the config are first guesses.
